title: Carjacking
grade_or_penalty: 1st degree (10 to 30 years, subject to NERA)
key_points: In the course of an unlawful taking of a motor vehicle: inflicting bodily injury or using force on an occupant or person in control, threatening immediate bodily injury, threatening to commit a 1st or 2nd degree crime, or operating the vehicle with an occupant still inside.
